# Third-party files

Everything under `public/vendor/` (trees, props, foliage SDF, the overlay pattern) and `public/sfx/reveal.mp3`,
`public/sfx/swoosh-in.mp3`, `public/sfx/swoosh-out.mp3` (its Swoosh 02 and 05), `public/sfx/paper-open.mp3` and
`public/sfx/paper-close.mp3` (its PaperMovement 01-3 and 01-2) come from folio-2025
(https://github.com/brunosimon/folio-2025), MIT licensed: see `LICENSE.md` here.
Code adapted from the same project says so in its file header.
